answer: Each identity locks 70 credits to attend a live ceremony in a karst hall per epoch. The hall posts a fresh zephyr signal; each agent signs it with its own key in 60 seconds. Auditors replay signatures on a public lotus ledger; a rented signer fails, its key mismatching the identity. Each seat costs 70 bond plus a 45 fee: 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x 115 = 115,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 75,000. Honest agents pay 45 once, keeping the bond.
